Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202134 Act Number: 34 Enactment Date: 2021-10-07 Act Year: 2021 Short Title: The Karnataka Prison Development Board Act, 2021. Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of the 'Karnataka Prison Development Board' for strengthening of Prisons and Correctional administration particularly Correctional interventions, welfare of Prisoners and Prisons Staff and expanding Prison industries, and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
